items.title: Are You Looking for a High-Growth Dividend Stock?
items.summary: Dividends are one of the best benefits to being a shareholder, but finding a great dividend stock is no easy task. Does U.S. Bancorp (USB) have what it takes? Let's find out.

items.title: Is U.S. Bancorp Stock Outperforming the Dow?
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp stock has outperformed the Dow Jones Index’s returns over the past year, and analysts are moderately upbeat about the financial services stock.

items.title: Truist vs. U.S. Bancorp: Both Pay $0.52, but Only One Dividend Is Growing
items.summary: Truist and U.S. Bancorp are writing shareholders identical checks this year, but underneath that matching number, one bank is quietly building momentum while the other sits frozen in place.

items.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Stock May Be 40% Undervalued On Business Banking Expansion
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp has delivered a very strong 91.5% share price gain over the past three years, yet several valuation checks still point to the stock trading below an estimate of its intrinsic value. For investors, the focus is on how that gap between the market price and the Excess Returns model compares with a more mixed overall value score. items.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Expands Business Banking Into Four Sun Belt States
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE: USB) announced a significant expansion of its business banking operations into Florida, Georgia, Texas, and Arizona. The move targets mid-sized businesses in Sun Belt states where U.S. Bank currently has a limited presence. The expansion includes a sizable hiring effort as the company seeks a broader national footprint. items.title: Can USB Turn Its Business Banking Expansion Into Sustainable Growth?
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp is broadening its business banking footprint with new markets, bankers and specialized offerings. Can expansion unlock stronger growth?

items.title: Major Bank CEO Liquidates Over $1.7 Million Worth of Stock
items.summary: Kedia exercised vested stock options at $55.01 per share and immediately sold them at $62.37, retaining a direct stake of 426,262 shares worth approximately $26.6 million.

items.title: Skip the Regional Bank Basket: These 3 Dividend Stocks Look Stronger
